recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆中型淋巴細胞的核有多處深凹、形成數個指狀／花瓣狀分葉，染色質濃縮，細胞質少而淡藍，符合 ATLL 的 flower cell 形態。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell, slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Nucleus with several deep indentations forming finger-like lobes (cloverleaf/flower pattern)
Condensed, dark chromatin without distinct nucleoli
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm with a thin darker rim
Background normocytic red cells, occasional crenated cell and small platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized atypical lymphoid cell with a deeply indented, multilobated nucleus forming finger-like lobes, condensed chromatin and scant pale-blue cytoplasm. Red cells are largely normocytic with an occasional crenated form, and scattered platelets are present. The nuclear configuration is characteristic of flower cells. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; HTLV-1 serology and T-cell immunophenotyping are recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells show a finely grooved cerebriform nucleus rather than discrete deep lobes and occur in HTLV-1-negative patients with erythroderma.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with nuclear clefting
ddx.vs: CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like chromatin and are CD5+ CD23+ B cells, with only occasional minor notches.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential hairy projections, not a lobulated nucleus with scant cytoplasm.
Neutrophils show granular pink cytoplasm and very coarse chromatin lobes joined by filaments.
